content_html:
#JanathaGarage : to put it short KortalaShiva’s version of RGV’s Sarkar!!!

though story wise n execution wise nothing new, POWER PACKED performances of MohanLal n NTR!!!!

NTR take a bow….his expressions dialogue delivery are simply EXCELLENT!!! especially the whole 2nd half…watching NTR’s movies have always been least priorty 4 me….Temper (watched 4 puri) NKP (watched 4 sukumar) n this one 4 the combination……but will ensure 2 watch his next movies only 4 him….hope he continues experimentation irrespective of commercial outcomes

#DSP BGM is still haunting me…..my ringtone is going 2 change

n now.coming to shiva….is this the start of downfall of kortalasiva?? RGV vadi vadi vadi padesinaaaa C (bhootulu vadule) story template ni as it is kotesadu….Hero env premikudu ane concept add chesadu but still he uses bike instead of cycle?? or atleast public transport (should have used atleast in 1st half)

coming to main heroine KajalAgarwal and supporting heroines Samantha n Nitya they did their job….
